The_Hindu_Andhra_Pradesh.Title: Rayalaseema landscape: Preserving the past, securing the future
The_Hindu_Andhra_Pradesh.Description: Rayalaseema region’s rich geological past is reflected in its basement rocks, which formed more than 2.5 billion years ago during the Precambrian era.
